description: A live camera preview that reads QR codes and one-dimensional barcodes of the chosen formats. Needs the `camera` device API: the plugin declares it, the app approves it (SEC-080), and the host declares the camera usage description. Ships in `plux_scanner`.

props.name: formats
props.description: The formats to read; every format when empty or absent.

props.name: scanWindow
props.description: The part of the preview that is read, as four fractions of the preview: left, top, width, height. The whole preview when absent.

props.name: continuous
props.description: Whether the scanner keeps reading after the first code; otherwise it reports once and stops.

props.name: overlayHint
props.description: A line of text under the viewfinder, such as "Point the camera at the code".

props.name: semanticLabel
props.description: What a screen reader announces for the scanner; the read value is announced when a code is detected.

events.name: onDetected
events.description: Fires with the code that was read. The value can be sensitive (a payment token, a ticket); do not log it or put it in a label.

events.name: onError
events.description: Fires with an error code when the camera is denied, missing or fails.
